text_block_list.text:
Хиши Амадзон and Нарита Брайан are
having a joint
training session.
Pant... Pant...
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
Haha! Man, goin' toe-to-toe with you
always gets
my heart pumpin'!
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
Phew... You've got some serious pluck
always
challenging me, y'know?
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text: Still, I can't say I'm not impressed.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан
choice_data_list: Nice work out there, you two.

text_block_list.text:
Thanks! But that was just a fraction of
what Brian
and I are capable of.
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
There's gotta be a way to make our
battles even
more intense...
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
Hey, I know! We can try doing that thing
I saw on
TV the other day!
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text: What thing?
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
Oh, it was just this thing pro athletes do
before a
match!
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
What was it called again? It's not curry
roux... and 
it's definitely not root beer...
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон
choice_data_list: Are you thinking of the word "routine?"

text_block_list.text: That's it, Teach! Phew, good save there.
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
Do you have a routine you stick to,
Brian?
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
I've never given it much thought, but... I
guess I
do.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
Can't say if this counts, but I like to clear
my mind
first before I start training or
racing.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
Hey, that sounds cool! You've gotta
teach me
your tricks!
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
Think of this as a way to spice up our
duels. What
do you say, Brian?
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
I'm only doing this once, so pay
attention. And if
you're serious about
this, we'll need a quiet spot
to
concentrate.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
And so, we trek to a mountain stream to
learn the
secrets of clearing one's mind.

Nnngh... I need to focus! Think... you're
in a race,
and everything is on the line!
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
You're thinking out loud, Ama. You just
gotta try
to calm your mind.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text: Nnngh!
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text: Gah! My head's about to burst!
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text: ...So much for that.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан
choice_data_list: How about we try a different routine?

text_block_list.text:
G-good suggestion. What do you think
would suit
me, Teach?
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон
choice_data_list: Pump yourself up with a huge yell.

text_block_list.text: Yeah, yellin' is kinda my forte. Okay!
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
Raaargh! Let's get this battle
staaarteeed!
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I'm feelin' it! All right, this's gonna
be my
new routine!
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
...Heh. You're gonna do that before
every match?
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
Yeah, why not? You'd better look
forward to our
next race!
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
Anyway, all this concentrating and
yelling's got
my stomach rumblin'.
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
Let's head back to the academy for some
lunch.
Don't worry, Brian, I've made food
for you too!
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text: ...Are there any vegetables in this?
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
Don't worry. I made sure everything will
taste
good even with your picky tastes!
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text: ...I guess I'll have some, then.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text: Huh? How will that help me?
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text: Books, eh? That's a good idea.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
You were the one who said pro athletes
tend to
have their own routines, Ama.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
I think your trainer's suggesting you look
for
books that talk about that stuff and
read them
for reference.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
Ooh, I get it now! Let's see what the
library has,
then.
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
Interesting... Some like to strike a
signature pose,
others like to touch their
uniform...
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
I'm seeing a lot of ideas, but I dunno
what I
should do!
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
...Y'know, if you studied this hard for
tests, you
wouldn't be borderline failing
them.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
Th-that's none of your business! And
you're the
last person I wanna hear that
from.
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
You never study either, so how come
you always
pass?
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
Cause I at least do the bare minimum. I'd
never
hear the end of it from Sis or the
student council
if I bombed my tests.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
Don't you dare ruin our next match by
flunking
your way into remedial classes,
Ama.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
I witness yet another side of their rivalry
as the
two bicker over their grades...

Their ambiguous relationship makes it
hard to
know if they're good friends or
bitter rivals, but I
have a good lunch
with the two of them.
